Si eres socio de la **Asociación Española de Speedcubing (AES)** a día 8 de junio de 2025 y participas en la competición se te reembolsará el 15% de la cuota de registro al finalizar ésta. Puedes hacerte socio de la AES pinchando [aquí](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/).

 ![Image description](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcTFGIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3848f5b35097c314ae86c51246a8e83fcf815ce2/t2O5Zsj.png) **English**
If you are **Spanish Speedcubing Association (AES)** member on June 8, 2025 and you participate in the competition, 15% of the registration fee will be reimbursed after the competition. You can join AES by clicking [here](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/).
